#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue arises because the password reset email link uses `BASE_URL` which defaults to `http://localhost:3000` if the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable is not set. To fix this, ensure that the environment variable `PUBLIC_URL` is correctly configured to the production URL before the application is built and deployed. This is why the reset link points to localhost for you and your team; the environment variable is likely missing or misconfigured in the deployed environment.
